description: This file defines a Java interface 'PlaceholderResolver' for resolving placeholders within a project. It extends another interface 'Placeholder' and provides methods for obtaining a source for placeholders and resolving placeholder names to their values, possibly returning a constant 'valid' if in validation mode.

classes.name: PlaceholderResolver
classes.description: An interface for resolving placeholders by name, optionally from a source, and possibly for validation purposes.

methods.name: getPlaceholderSource
methods.description: Returns an Optional source object from which placeholder values can be resolved.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves a placeholder by name, using the source if available, or returns an Optional containing 'valid' if used for validation.
